name: NAICA
description:
About This Game

Descend NAICA

Play as Don, an old adventurer delving vast crystal caves with his trusty grappling hook in search of a legendary treasure.

Venture through magical, beautiful, and dangerous caves where every descent tests your resilience, reflexes, and even creativity. As you delve deeper, challenge will rise, and it will become more difficult to reach the bottom, and claim the bountiful treasure.

But persevere, master the art of the grappling hook and crystal-powered dash, and claim the TREASURE!

Game Features

  • A challenging and engaging experience that will push your skills to the limit.

  • Grumpy old man.

  • Master the grappling hook in combination with the crystal powered dash.

  • A humorous and silly narrative.

  • Tons of hand crafted unique levels, each with its own identity and trials.

  • Cozy campfires to rest.

  • Hand drawn pixel-art made with love.

  • Discover diverse zones that introduce new mechanics and constantly reinvent the gameplay.

  • Overcome obstacles in creative and unexpected ways.

  • An epic original soundtrack.

  • Special challenge levels featuring wild twists and unexpected ways to play.

  • LEGENDARY TREASURE.
short_desc: Descend into magical crystal caves with your trusty grappling hook in this challenging 2D precision platformer. Swing, dash, and overcome increasingly demanding obstacles as your skills are pushed to their limit.
